Stages: Ava starts at Infant. The stage limits what the model can trigger on its own (triage
ladder). Promotion is advisory: Ava never promotes herself.

The model proposes gmail_send. decide() and the Gmail skill create a sealed card holding the draft hash. The owner opens Approvals, sees the recipient, subject and body, and taps approve. resolve() re-fetches the Gmail draft, compares its hash with the sealed one,
and only then sends. If someone edited the draft in between, nothing is sent. The email carries the AI-assistant signature line unless the owner unticks it for that email.
